title: GTA 6 Ultimate Edition Guide: How to Get Pre-Order Bonuses
description: Learn how to unlock and collect your GTA 6 Ultimate Edition items and pre-order bonuses, including vehicles, weapons, and cosmetics across the map.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Ultimate Edition Guide: Unlocking Your Pre-Order Bonuses

For players looking to get the absolute most out of Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster, the $100 Ultimate Edition of *GTA 6* presents an enticing package. Featuring a diverse collection of in-game items, vehicles, weapons, and cosmetic options, it is designed to give early adopters a stylish edge in the streets of Vice City and beyond.

According to a recent report by gaming outlet Push Square, unlocking these high-value goodies isn't as simple as opening your inventory right away. The contents of the Ultimate Edition and pre-order bonuses are unlocked at **different points throughout the story**, and some specific items will even require players to travel to designated locations scattered across the massive open-world map to collect them.

### What to Expect from Your Rewards

While the exact lineup of items varies, players who invest in the premium edition or secure early pre-orders typically gain access to:

* **Exclusive Vehicles**: Custom-tuned rides that stand out on the highway, usually tied to specific garages or map coordinates.
* **Advanced Weaponry**: Specialized firearms to help you survive early-game challenges.
* **Cosmetic Upgrades**: Unique outfits and visual customization options for the protagonists.

### Tips for Claiming Your Items Smoothly

To ensure you don't miss out on any of your hard-earned digital extras, keep these steps in mind when diving into the game:

1. **Progress the Story**: Do not panic if your items aren't immediately available. Many rewards are gated behind specific narrative milestones and story chapters.
2. **Explore the Map**: Keep an eye out for map markers or specific pickup locations mentioned in guides to retrieve items hidden across the game world.
3. **Check In-Game Notifications**: Pay attention to pop-up alerts that confirm when your DLC items or pre-order bonuses have successfully been added to your account.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar's approach of tying premium and pre-order rewards to story progression and map exploration is a clever way to balance early-game advantages. Instead of completely breaking the game's economy or challenge curve on day one, these items serve as satisfying milestones as you immerse yourself in the new world. It rewards patience and exploration, ensuring that opening your bonus gear feels like a genuine event rather than a routine download.
